_comment: Hand-authored barrier-city catalogue (board #3789, parent #3788). A regenerate-through input, sibling of hub_worksheet.json / inland_lakes.json — edited deliberately, never inferred from a bitmap. One row per canon settlement that sits in/against a barrier terrain and would be silently sealed out of the playable map if the hand-drawn impassable-terrain layer were painted over it. `name` is the display text; `anchor` is a canvas [x,y] pixel (identity is the anchor geometry, never a STATE_ key — the Hilbert STATE number churns); `realm` is a grouping/log label; `terrain` is one of mountain|marsh|forest|cliff_coast (schema._CITY_TERRAINS); `source` is the canon citation; `note` is optional. render_canon_cities_preview.py draws these as a labelled overlay + a transparent GIMP layer to paint around; validate_map._check_canon_cities warns if an anchor lands on water or under the impassable fill. Seed slice: a World's-Edge / Karaz Ankor proving cluster (board #3789 wave-1) — first-pass by-eye anchors on land beside the current impassable draft, PROVISIONAL pending Chris's visual verdict on the render.
